## Purpose and scope

Explain the problem and the intended change. Link the issue or protocol where applicable.

## Change type

- [ ] Documentation or presentation
- [ ] Artifact portability or validation
- [ ] Numerical analysis change
- [ ] New experimental evidence

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. Explicitly identify unrun checks.

## Evidence and safety

- [ ] Original results, frozen inputs, and release assets are preserved.
- [ ] No large datasets, indexes, credentials, or restricted materials are added.
- [ ] Links, manifests, and stated reproduction scope match the change.
- [ ] Scientific claims and reported numbers remain traceable to evidence.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the repository checks and evidence-preservation rules.
